title: Intro to JavaScript
line: Values, functions, arrays and objects. Scripts you run with Node.

project.title: A workout log
project.brief: Write workouts.js on your own. Keep a list of workout objects, add to it with a function, total the minutes for each kind with reduce and print a weekly report with template literals.
checks: workouts.js runs with node and no error
The report prints one line per kind of workout with its minutes
The grand total equals the sum of every workout

lessons.title: Run your first JavaScript file
lessons.goal: Teach a complete beginner to create hello.js in VS Code, print two lines with console.log and run it from the terminal with node.
lessons.passes: hello.js runs and prints both lines.

lessons.title: Let, const and numbers
lessons.goal: Teach JavaScript let, const and arithmetic by building a dinner bill splitter in split.js with a total, a number of people and a share each.
lessons.passes: split.js prints 30 as the share of a 120 dollar bill split four ways.

lessons.title: Strings and template literals
lessons.goal: Teach JavaScript strings, length, toUpperCase and template literals by printing a shipping label from a name, a street and a city.
lessons.passes: The label prints three lines with the name in capitals.

lessons.title: If, else and comparisons
lessons.goal: Teach JavaScript comparisons, strict equality and if, else if, else by writing a password strength checker that prints weak, okay or strong.
lessons.passes: Passwords of 4, 9 and 14 characters print weak, okay and strong.

lessons.title: For and while loops
lessons.goal: Teach JavaScript for and while loops and the remainder operator by writing FizzBuzz for the numbers 1 to 30.
lessons.passes: The output has 30 lines with Fizz, Buzz and FizzBuzz in the right places.

lessons.title: Functions and arrow functions
lessons.goal: Teach JavaScript functions, parameters, return values and arrow functions by writing a reading time estimator, once as a function declaration and once as an arrow function.
lessons.passes: Both versions print 5 minutes for a text of 1000 words at 200 a minute.

lessons.title: Arrays
lessons.goal: Teach JavaScript arrays by building a playlist. Push, pop, find a song with includes and indexOf, slice the first three and loop with for of.
lessons.passes: The playlist prints with the new song added and the last one removed.

lessons.title: Map, filter and reduce
lessons.goal: Teach the JavaScript array methods map, filter and reduce by pricing a cart. Drop items under 5 dollars, add tax to the rest and sum the total.
lessons.passes: The total matches the taxed sum of the items that cost 5 dollars or more.

lessons.title: Objects
lessons.goal: Teach JavaScript objects, properties, methods and arrays of objects by building an address book of three contacts and printing each one.
lessons.passes: The script prints the name and phone of all three contacts.

lessons.title: Promises and async await
lessons.goal: Teach JavaScript promises and async await by writing a wait function with setTimeout and a tea timer that prints three steps in order.
lessons.passes: The three steps print in order, about one second apart.
